result.summary: Identified a layout bug where text elements overlap and minor styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: The delivery time and delivery fee text overlap below the restaurant title, making them illegible.
issues.suggestion: Increase the horizontal spacing or use a different layout for delivery metadata to avoid collisions.

issues.description: The use of simplified vector illustrations for food items lacks visual consistency with a professional delivery app.
issues.suggestion: Replace generic illustrations with high-quality, actual food photography for better user engagement.
